title: B2 connectors for structured answers
summary: Use connectors to signal contrast, cause, consequence and qualification instead of chaining short sentences.

blocks.text: Use connectors to signal contrast, cause, consequence and qualification instead of chaining short sentences.

items: for det første / for det andre
på den ene siden … på den andre siden

blocks.question: Give a contrast connector suitable for a formal B2 answer.
blocks.answer: imidlertid, likevel, or the pair på den ene siden … på den andre siden, depending on the sentence.

sources.title: Språkrådet (Language Council of Norway)
